resources.string: This app shares this device\'s location with the parent account it is paired to. Please read this and only continue if you agree.
Your location is sent to your parent\'s account, roughly once a minute while you are moving.
It keeps sharing in the background, even when the app is closed and after the phone restarts.
While sharing is on, a permanent notification is shown, so it is never a secret.
You can stop sharing at any time, from this app or straight from that notification.
Nothing else is collected: no messages, no contacts, no call history, no photos, no microphone, no list of the apps you use.
Your parent can also turn sharing off from their side. If they do, this app tells you.
Nothing is shared until you agree. You can open this app again whenever you are ready.
Your parent created a code in their dashboard. Type it here to link this device to their account.
8 letters and numbers. The dash is optional and it is not case sensitive.
A pairing code is 8 characters long.
That code is not valid, has expired, or has already been used. Ask your parent for a new one.
Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
The server could not complete pairing right now. Please try again in a moment.
Android asks for each of these separately. We explain what every one is for before asking.
Android will not ask again. You can still change this in system settings.
Android needs your permission to show notifications. Without it the ongoing sharing notification is hidden, and location would be shared with nothing on screen telling you so.
This is the location that is shared with your parent. Please choose the precise option: an approximate location can be several hundred metres out, which is not much use for finding you.
Without this, location is only shared while this app is open on screen. Sharing is meant to keep working when the phone is in a pocket or a bag.
Android does not ask for this inside the app. Open settings, tap Permissions, then Location, and choose \"%1$s\".
Android does not ask for this inside the app. Open settings, tap Permissions, then Location, and choose the option that allows access all the time.
Optional. Android may put this app to sleep to save battery, which leaves gaps in the shared location. Turning optimisation off for this app makes those gaps much less likely.
This one is optional. Sharing still works without it, with occasional gaps.
Notifications are switched off, so you will not see the ongoing sharing notification.
Location permission is missing. Nothing can be shared until it is allowed.
Only approximate location is allowed, so shared positions may be several hundred metres out.
Background location is not allowed, so sharing pauses whenever this app leaves the screen.
The ongoing notification shown the whole time this device is sharing its location.
Location sharing is on — your parent can see this device\'s location
One-off messages about sharing being turned on or off.
Location sharing was turned off by your parent
This device is no longer linked to their account and has stopped sending its location.
This device is not paired yet
Sharing was turned off by your parent
This device is no longer linked to a parent account. Nothing is being sent. Ask your parent for a new pairing code if it should be linked again.
Android would not let sharing start while the app was in the background. Open the app and turn sharing on again.
Sharing cannot start without location permission.
Sharing cannot start until this device is paired.
The last upload failed. Locations are queued and will be sent when the connection is back.

Sharing stops immediately, the stored pairing token is deleted from this device, and any locations still waiting to be sent are discarded. A new pairing code from your parent is needed to link it again.
This device has been unpaired and is no longer sharing its location.
